INSERT INTO stock_daily_bar (canonical_symbol, trade_date, adjust_type, data_source, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume, amount, fetched_at) VALUES
(#{item.canonicalSymbol}, #{item.tradeDate}, #{item.adjustType}, #{item.dataSource}, #{item.openPrice}, #{item.highPrice}, #{item.lowPrice}, #{item.closePrice}, #{item.volume}, #{item.amount}, #{item.fetchedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = VALUES(open_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), amount = VALUES(amount), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
